material_delta.summary: Provision the Puppeteer-compatible Chrome binary before the repository test gate; no product, domain, schema, route, documentation, or test semantics changed.
material_delta.reuse_basis: The exact-head Validate PR run re-executed the complete repository gates and the full-stack browser/HTTP/PostgreSQL regression after the workflow-only fix.

root_cause.failure: Puppeteer could not find Chrome 127.0.6533.88 on the GitHub-hosted runner, causing profile-review-fullstack-http-browser.integration.test.ts to fail during browser launch before assertions.
root_cause.remediation: Added an explicit pnpm --filter @corrida/api exec puppeteer browsers install chrome step after dependency installation.
